messages:
ana: Heads up — eu-west-2 is showing a persistent burst skewing allocations toward rack-hemisphere-A. Warm-pool prefill isn't absorbing the pressure; we're seeing many small tenant 'bubbles' fragmenting slots and causing repeated cold-start churn. Can we coordinate a temporary hemisphere carve + prefill for a subset of racks to buy us time?
ops-bot: Alert: allocation_skew_detected; region=eu-west-2; skew_ratio=0.72; affected_racks=12,13,14,15; severity=warning.
sam: Link to dashboards: https://dashboards.internal/redwood/eu-west-2/allocations (see rack heatmap, last 30m).
wei: Quick read — NIC error counters + pcie_tx spikes on racks 12/13. Not pure scheduler; I suspect a network neighbor effect where a few tenants are causing hot NVLink/PCIe bursts. Snippet: ```pcie_tx/errors: rack12: 120->980 in 12m
net_drop: rack13: 0.1%->1.2%```
miguel: Proposal: run a targeted hemisphere carve for racks 12-14 (move warm-slices to hemisphere-B, prefill 6 slices per rack, throttle batch placements for the carve window). Estimated cost +0.8% for ~90m but should reduce churn and SLO noise. Steps: 1) mark racks 12-14 as carve-candidates 2) run burst-coord script 3) observe SLO telemetry 4) roll back if latency uplift > 15% for 5m.
janet: Need to be careful about dedicated-tenants on those racks — set soft-affinity thresholds to avoid evicting reserved capacity. Config patch suggestion: ```allocator.soft_affinity_threshold: 0.85
allocator.avoid_dedicated_evictions: true```
ana: typo — my name is ana (already correct).
ana: (ignore previous) OK, agree with Miguel's plan but prefer canary on racks 12-13 only to start. Sam, can you coordinate the run and add a canary flag? :thumbsup:
sam: Kicked off canary run on racks 12-13: ``./ops/burst-coord.sh --region eu-west-2 --hemisphere-target B --racks 12,13 --prefill 6 --canary``
ops-bot: Action started: rebalancer_job_id=84721; mode=canary; target_hemisphere=B; racks=[12,13]; timestamp=6639999999
wei: Watching NIC counters. If pcie_tx continues to climb after prefill we should immediately throttle large-batch inference queues. I'll open a quick patch to the task-shedder. PR: https://git.internal/redwood/ops/patch/912
miguel: If the canary looks good, we'll expand to rack 14. Also flag to billing: short cost delta up to +1% for the window.
janet: Rollback plan if we see increased latency for dedicated customers: revert annotations with ```kubectl annotate node rack-12 redwood.io/hemisphere-locked- -``` and run reassign script with --force-revert. Put an ops hold on any automated backfills during revert.
sam: Canary run showing initial prefill success, 6 slices started on racks 12/13, latency delta: +2% p95 app-layer. Still monitoring.
ops-bot: rebalancer_job_id=84721 status=partial_complete progress=46%
ana: (again) ana: I'll watch SLO dashboards and decide on expansion after 15m. If anything spikes I will abort and trigger rollback.
miguel: noted. If successful, we should write a short playbook for hemisphere carves so on-call knows steps next time.
janet: Agreed. Also add a safety check to prevent carving racks with active dedicated pools.
ana: Thanks everyone — will update in 15m.
